capture_enabled.name: Enable camera capture
capture_enabled.description: Leave off until references and MQTT have been checked. Restart after changing options.

camera_url.name: Camera RTSP URL
camera_url.description: Full RTSP URL, including camera credentials when needed. Never included in logs.

capture_interval.name: Capture interval (seconds)
capture_interval.description: One serial recognition round per interval; missed rounds are skipped.

expire_after.name: Observation expiry (seconds)
expire_after.description: Must exceed capture interval + camera timeout + 10. Stale observations become unavailable.

mqtt_enabled.name: Enable MQTT discovery and states
mqtt_enabled.description: Enable before capture to discover the initially unavailable Occupant sensor.

mqtt_tls.name: Use verified MQTT TLS
mqtt_tls.description: Use system CA trust and hostname verification. Plain MQTT is unencrypted; use only on a trusted network.

device_id.name: Stable MQTT device ID
device_id.description: Keep this unchanged after discovery. Use a different ID from the legacy cron device.

transfer_enabled.name: Enable HTTPS reference transfers
transfer_enabled.description: Also map the host port under Network. LAN/VPN only; never use router port forwarding.

transfer_token_name.name: Transfer client name
transfer_token_name.description: A descriptive name for the primary CLI client.

transfer_token_scope.name: Transfer client permissions
transfer_token_scope.description: Write permits reference uploads; read permits only status and downloads.

transfer_token_sha256.name: Transfer token SHA256 (optional)
transfer_token_sha256.description: Paste the digest printed by CLI pairing, not the certificate fingerprint. Leave empty to lock transfers; clear and restart to revoke.

transfer_tokens.name: Additional transfer clients (optional)
transfer_tokens.description: Usually leave empty. For multiple clients, add a text row per client: name|read-or-write|SHA256. No brackets or JSON.

store_captures.name: Save captured images
store_captures.description: Optional. Named predictions stay under unreviewed and never become references automatically.

capture_storage_mb.name: Combined capture/result storage cap (MiB)
capture_storage_mb.description: Oldest files are removed first. Reviewed references are not removed by retention.

minimum_free_mb.name: Minimum free disk space (MiB)
minimum_free_mb.description: New captures and uploads stop before consuming this reserve.

chicken_area.name: Minimum hen area
chicken_area.description: Presence heuristic in the 640×360 processing frame, not an identity feature.

max_distance.name: Maximum identity distance
max_distance.description: A larger distance produces unknown, not a forced identity. Scores are not probabilities.

min_margin.name: Minimum identity separation
min_margin.description: Require this gap between the two nearest identities; ambiguous observations remain unknown.

horizontal_left.name: Left boundary
horizontal_left.description: Left edge in the 640×360 processing frame. Default 0; type a number, not brackets.

horizontal_right.name: Right boundary
horizontal_right.description: Right edge in the 640×360 processing frame. Default 640; must be greater than the left boundary.

excluded_rectangles.name: Camera overlay/wall exclusions (optional)
excluded_rectangles.description: Leave empty for none. Add one text row per rectangle: x1,y1,x2,y2, without brackets. Coordinates use the 640×360 frame; never assign identities by position.

log_level.name: Log level
log_level.description: Info logs changes and actionable failures; debug adds round timing, never credentials.

network.8443/tcp: Pinned HTTPS reference-transfer API; map a host port to enable LAN/VPN access
